Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy.
Home Lko. on 15 February, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13339
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1658 of 2024
Applicant :- Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Saquib Zia Khan,Manav Gupta,Praveen Kumar Yadav,Shivanshu Goswa
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
3.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.587 of 2023, under Section 376(D), 376(2)(n),
506 IPC and Section 67A of IT Act, P.S. Sushant Golf City, District Lucknow.

4. In terms of FIR No.587 of 2023, it was alleged that the victim could not narrate the exact incident in the earlier FIR No.346 of 2023 in which a statement was given on 11.09.2023, as such, this FIR Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15174314/
1 was being lodged.

entities.text: Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was stated that the victim became friendly with the applicant through Instagram in February, 2023 and she was called to Lucknow, when she went there, some drink was administered and on false pretext of marriage, physical relations were formed.
It was stated that certain videographs were also made viral.
It was also stated that her ex-husband has also threatened to make the videographs viral.

It is argued that the co-accused against whom allegations of rape were also levelled has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 17.01.2024 passed in Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No.530 of 2024.

entities.text:
Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No.530 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
He also points out that the applicant has a criminal history of an offence under Section 427, 504, 506 IPC being FIR No.46 of 2022.
6. Reverting to the said submission of learned AGA, counsel for the applicant states that he is not aware of the said case shown as criminal history.

7. Considering the nature of the criminal antecedent being a minor offence, the fact that the FIR was lodged after a considerable delay of about eight months and there being no corroboration with any material on record, as well as the fact that the co-accused has been enlarged on bail, a case for bail is made out.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 nishant  Amir Khan @ Amir Ali Khan vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
